faqs.q: How do I notify SafeWork NSW about asbestos removal work?
faqs.a: You can notify SafeWork NSW of asbestos removal work using this link.

faqs.q: What do I need to do if I want to use explosives or store security sensitive dangerous substances?
faqs.a: You can apply for various licenses, such as a blasting explosives user licence, or prepare a security plan for storage.

faqs.q: How do I apply for a fireworks licence or notify a display?
faqs.a: You can apply for a fireworks (single use) licence, apply for a pyrotechnician's licence, or lodge a fireworks display notification.
